name: Indori Namkeen
instructions: 1. Prepare a thick, smooth dough using gram flour, turmeric, red chili powder, salt, and oil.
2. Use a sev press (sancha) to drop the dough into hot oil, frying until golden and crispy.
3. Separately fry poha, peanuts, and curry leaves in hot oil until crunchy.
4. In a large bowl, combine the crispy sev, fried poha, and peanuts.
5. Sprinkle with black salt, dry mango powder, and asafoetida, tossing well to coat the mixture evenly.
6. Store in an airtight container once cooled.
description: Indori Namkeen is the culinary identity of Indore, reflecting the city's obsession with savory snacks. It is a staple of Indori breakfast and evening tea, known for its unique blend of sweet, spicy, and tangy flavors, often served as a topping on Poha.
